steps: the workspace is cross built for the target of the host
the bundle of the instance is assembled
the instance is started by hand on the host
the Core of the host answers through the loopback of the client
the session of the operator is authorized and the projection is delivered
the instance publishes no port of the host
the instance stops and the services of the operator are unchanged
